visualCharacteristics.purpose: Paged rail of related-page teasers at the foot of a page
visualCharacteristics.layout: Three teasers per page with prev/next arrows and dots (>= 720); stacked first three plus load-more button (< 720)
notable: Image teasers with theme line, linked heading, text and Lesen arrow CTA
A slide may stack two text-only teasers when two headings are authored

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: optional picture, theme paragraph, linked heading, text paragraph and a Lesen CTA paragraph; two headings in one row stack two text-only teasers

usage: Use near the end of a page to point readers to related pages.
reuseGuidance: Fits image or text teasers linking to other pages; not for in-page navigation or a fixed grid of cards.
